law_record.title: Operation of vehicle on approach of authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of regulatory agency (2)(a)
law_record.text: Upon approaching an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency which is moving or preparing to move in any direction, including, without limitation, arriving at or leaving the scene of a crash or other incident, and making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of any other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: Decrease the speed of his or her vehicle to a speed that is reasonable and proper, pursuant to the criteria set forth in subsection 1 of NRS 484B.600 [NRS-484B-600-1a]. As used in this section, “preparing to move” means any indication that is visible to an approaching driver that an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency is about to move, including, without limitation: (a) A movement of the vehicle; or (b) The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle.

activation_conditions: an emergency or regulatory-agency vehicle with the required flashing lights is moving or preparing to move, including arriving at or leaving an incident
exceptions: when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
residue: 'reasonable and proper' is a judgement element, imported from the basic speed rule
'preparing to move' is defined by visible indications, so an unobserved hand signal makes the activation unknown
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the decrease must occur on the approach — before the subject reaches the vehicle
the reduced speed is held while passing
